Hi Samantha & Tom —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery + the asks we discussed so we can align internally and keep momentum: 

1) Stakeholder mapping (please confirm):
   - Economic buyer: Priya Nair (CFO) — will own budget/approval
   - Security/infosec lead: Harish Kumar — will own questionnaire/controls review
   - Procurement contact: procurement@acme-fintech.com — vendor onboarding / PO

2) Procurement / vendor onboarding items we should expect:
   - Required vendor registration form + tax docs (W-9)
   - Standard SOW + PO flow; they typically issue PO after vendor registration and SOW approval
   - Invoice remit: invoices@acme-fintech.com (please confirm PO# requirement)

3) Timeline: you mentioned ~4–6 weeks for onboarding + PO after SOW signoff — please confirm any hard dates (e.g., fiscal cutoffs).

Next steps / who does what:
- Samantha: confirm stakeholder emails and procurement timeline (can procurement complete vendor portal this week?)
- Tom: confirm whether Harish wants a separate security deep-dive or if we should start with the questionnaire we attached.
- Me (Marissa): I’ll loop in Dylan for the security questionnaire and Avery for contract/pricing/discount approvals. I attached a draft pricing quote and our vendor onboarding form to get the ball rolling.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-quote.pdf, vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx

Would you be available for a 20-min follow-up next Tue/Wed to finalize the vendor steps?

Best,

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Economic buyer is Priya Nair (CFO) — priya.nair@acme-fintech.com (she reviews final TCO and signs off on POs).
- Security lead is Harish Kumar (harish.kumar@acme-fintech.com). He typically wants the vendor security questionnaire + SOC2 summary.
- Procurement is procurement@acme-fintech.com (I’ve CC'd them). 

Procurement notes (from Tom): they require vendor registration in the portal, a completed vendor form, and a W-9. Once vendor registration is complete and legal signs the SOW, they issue a PO. Typical turnaround is 3–6 weeks depending on timing. If you can upload the vendor form to their portal it speeds things up.

We can do a short sync next Wednesday at 10:00am PT — does that work for you?

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the submission. We received the vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx and W-9. Next steps from procurement: 
1) We will start vendor registration in our portal and aim to complete registration by next Wed (11 Mar).
2) Once registration is complete and legal has executed the SOW, we will issue a PO. Please ensure invoices include the PO number and are sent to invoices@acme-fintech.com.
